definitions.explanation: The two small lumps of tissue at the back of the throat, which swell when infected.

examples.japanese: {扁桃腺|へんとうせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{腫|は}れた→腫れる：12325_hareru⟧。
{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ころ{扁桃腺|へんとうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I had my tonsils out as a child.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧{扁桃腺|へんとうせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{腫|は}れて→腫れる：12325_hareru⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Whenever I catch a cold, my tonsils swell up and I run a high fever.

notes:
{扁桃|へんとう} (almond, from the shape) + ⟦{腺|せん}→腺：17997_sen⟧ (gland). Doctors now say {扁桃|へんとう}; {扁桃腺|へんとうせん} is the everyday word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {扁桃腺|へんとうせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{腫|は}れる→腫れる：12325_hareru⟧: one's tonsils swell
- {扁桃腺炎|へんとうせんえん}: tonsillitis
- {扁桃腺|へんとうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to have one's tonsils out
